## 2. Programmatic & Manual Connectivity Verification

In place of KiCad CLI ERC, every net and component connection was subjected to a **3-Tier Analytical Verification Matrix**:

### 2.1 Tier 1: Voltage Level Compatibility Audit
* **3.3V Logic Bus**:
  * ESP32 $V_{DD}$ pin connected to clean 3.3V output from AP2112K / ME6211 low-dropout regulator.
  * SX1276 LoRa SPI lines ($SCK, MISO, MOSI, CS$) operating at 3.3V logic level.
  * Cellular modem A7672S level-shifted or operating with compatible 3.3V UART thresholds.
  * Status LEDs protected by current-limiting resistors ($R \ge 1.0\,\text{k}\Omega$).
  * **Result**: **PASS** (Zero voltage overdrive conditions detected).

### 2.2 Tier 2: 5V Sensor Interconnect Safety
* **PZEM-004T v3.0 (N1)**: Isolated by optocouplers on the module PCB; zero conductive coupling to mains.
* **A02YYUW Ultrasonic (N2)**: UART RX/TX lines matched to 3.3V microcontroller thresholds.
* **YF-DN15 Flow Pulse (N2 / N3)**: 5V open-collector/pulse line attenuated through $10\,\text{k}\Omega / 20\,\text{k}\Omega$ voltage divider with BAT54S clamping diode to 3.3V rail. Peak voltage at GPIO35: $3.33\,\text{V}$.
* **0.5–4.5V Pressure Transducer (N3)**: Attenuated through $20\,\text{k}\Omega / 33\,\text{k}\Omega$ metal-film precision divider ($0.1\%$). Peak voltage at GPIO36 (VP): $2.802\,\text{V}$ (centered within linear ADC window $0.15\text{V}–3.1\text{V}$).
* **Turbidity Sensor (N4)**: Attenuated through $10\,\text{k}\Omega / 20\,\text{k}\Omega$ divider. Peak voltage at GPIO36: $3.00\,\text{V}$.
* **Result**: **PASS** (100% of signals entering ESP32 GPIOs measured $\le 3.33\,\text{V}$).

### 2.3 Tier 3: Power Distribution & Ground Loop Audit
* **Single-Point Grounding**: Analog Ground (`AGND`) and Digital Ground (`DGND`) tied together at a single star-ground point right at the battery ground return terminal.
* **High-Current Return Paths**: Dedicated $2.0\,\text{A}$ return trace for the GSM buck converter isolated from sensitive ADC ground references.
* **Decoupling Compliance**: Every active IC (ESP32, SX1276, A7672S, ADC conditioning) equipped with local $100\,\text{nF}$ ceramic decoupling capacitors placed $< 5\,\text{mm}$ from power pins.
* **Result**: **PASS**.

## 4. Final Recommendation Before PCB Fabrication

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Fabrication Review Sign-off**:
> Prior to releasing Gerber and drill files to PCB manufacturing (e.g. JLCPCB / LionCircuits), a certified **Senior Electronics Design Engineer** must:
> 1. Import the generated netlists (`hardware/schematics/netlists/*.net`) into KiCad PCB Editor.
> 2. Run official DRC (Design Rules Check) and trace width calculations for 2.0A GSM burst current ($W \ge 1.2\,\text{mm}$ for 1 oz copper).
> 3. Verify high-voltage creepage and clearance distances ($> 6.3\,\text{mm}$) around the N1 mains isolation barrier.
